dialogues.jp: そうか……俺は券売機の下の方を見つめた。
dialogues.en: I see... I look at the bottom of the vending machine.
dialogues.text: I see... I look at the bottom of the vending machine.

dialogues.jp:
ここの券売機には、不思議にも品名がなく値段
のみ記されたボタンが幾つか生きているのだ。
dialogues.en:
Strangely, this vending machine has a few buttons with no
dish names but only the price tags.
dialogues.text:
Strangely, this vending machine has a few buttons with no
dish names but only the price tags.

dialogues.jp:
過去、杉並をして語りたくないと言わしめた料
理が出たらしいのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I heard that in the past, there was a dish that nobody,
including Suginami, wanted to even talk about again.
dialogues.text:
I heard that in the past, there was a dish that nobody,
including Suginami, wanted to even talk about again.

dialogues.jp: 「ならば、期待には応えねばなるまい」
dialogues.en: "Well then, this is my turn to solve the mystery."
dialogues.text: "Well then, this is my turn to solve the mystery."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃむ？　なんか嫌なオーラ受信？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Did you detect some kind of aura?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Did you detect some kind of aura?"

dialogues.jp:
ピンとリボンを立てて小首をかしげる｛さくら／兎｝を横目
に、何気ない動作で謎のボタンを押す。
dialogues.en:
As Sakura cocks her head at me, I ignore her and press the
mysterious button.
dialogues.text:
As Sakura cocks her head at me, I ignore her and press the
mysterious button.

dialogues.jp: ぽちっとな。
dialogues.en: I press it lightly.
dialogues.text: I press it lightly.

dialogues.jp:
んべ〜、と出てきた食券を、さくらが手にとっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Sakura picks up the food ticket that came out of the
machine.
dialogues.text:
Sakura picks up the food ticket that came out of the
machine.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なに買っ……あ」
dialogues.en: "What is this?"
dialogues.text: "What is this?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにが出てきた？」
dialogues.en: "What did you get?"
dialogues.text: "What did you get?"

dialogues.jp:
俺が舌なめずりして覗きこもうとすると、なぜ
かさくらが後ずさる。
dialogues.en:
I lick my lips and try to see the ticket, but Sakura draws
back from me.
dialogues.text:
I lick my lips and try to see the ticket, but Sakura draws
back from me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あぁ、お兄ちゃん……これは駄目……人
　間としてノーサンキュー」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, no, oniichan... This is not good... I say no thanks as
a human being."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, no, oniichan... This is not good... I say no thanks as
a human being."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「おい、変な物でも金はかかってるんだから注
　文だけでもしようや」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, even if it's a bizarre food, I already paid for it so
we should order anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, even if it's a bizarre food, I already paid for it so
we should order anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おい」
dialogues.en: "Come on."
dialogues.text: "Come on."

dialogues.jp:
分かりやすい泣き声をあげ、食券を腕ごと背中
に隠して、さくらが首を横に振る。
dialogues.en:
She cries out, and then shakes her head, hiding the food
ticket behind her back.
dialogues.text:
She cries out, and then shakes her head, hiding the food
ticket behind her back.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ごめん……ボク……お兄ちゃんの頼みでもこ
　れだけは舐められない……」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry, oniichan. I could never lick this even if you begged
me."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry, oniichan. I could never lick this even if you begged
me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ舐めるって……とりあえず品名だけで
　も見せ――」
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean by lick? Can I see the name of the dish at
least?"
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean by lick? Can I see the name of the dish at
least?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うわ〜ん！　へんた〜い！　さのばびっ
　ち〜！」
dialogues.en: "Aaaahhn! You pervert! Son of a bitch!"
dialogues.text: "Aaaahhn! You pervert! Son of a bitch!"

dialogues.jp:
食堂の注目を浴びながら、さくらが物凄い勢い
で部屋を出ていく。
dialogues.en:
Sakura dashes out of the dining hall, getting everybody's
attention.
dialogues.text:
Sakura dashes out of the dining hall, getting everybody's
attention.

dialogues.jp: 「……俺か？　俺のせいなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Me? Is it my fault?"
dialogues.text: "Me? Is it my fault?"

dialogues.jp: クスッ。
dialogues.en: Teehee.
dialogues.text: Teehee.

dialogues.jp:
振りかえった券売機の向こうで、食堂のおばちゃ
ん達がニヤリと笑っていた。
dialogues.en:
I turn around, and see the old gals who work here grinning
at me from behind the vending machine.
dialogues.text:
I turn around, and see the old gals who work here grinning
at me from behind the vending machine.

dialogues.jp: ◆ぶるぶる◆
dialogues.en: ◆Shivering◆
dialogues.text: ◆Shivering◆

dialogues.jp:
好奇心に身を任せて、謎の食券にチャレンジす
る俺。
dialogues.en:
I took a chance on the mysterious food ticket out of
curiosity.
dialogues.text:
I took a chance on the mysterious food ticket out of
curiosity.

dialogues.jp:
その食券を手にしたさくらが、なぜか首をぶる
ぶると振りつつ逃げ出してしまう。
dialogues.en:
When Sakura saw the ticket, she ran out of the dining hall,
shaking her head.
dialogues.text:
When Sakura saw the ticket, she ran out of the dining hall,
shaking her head.

dialogues.jp:
そうして、謎の食券の謎はそのまま改名される
ことなく消えてしまった……。
dialogues.en:
In the meantime, the mysterious food ticket has gone without
me finding out its true name.
dialogues.text:
In the meantime, the mysterious food ticket has gone without
me finding out its true name.
